The Indo-Greeks were the first dynasty to issue gold coins in India [d1][d2][d3][d6][d7]. Multiple sources explicitly state the Indo-Greeks introduced gold coins, with some noting this occurred around 270 BC [d2]. While Kushan rulers later issued significant quantities of gold coins [d1][d5], the historical precedence is consistently attributed to the Indo-Greek rulers.
